scripts.build:log: powershell -Command "$OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; '[' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') + '] Starting build...' | Out-File -Encoding utf8 logs.txt; turbo build 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 -Append logs.txt"
